methodology.durability: fsync/full_page_writes/synchronous_commit on; tmpfs is NOT a physical disk durability benchmark
methodology.layout: Migrated schema clones retain CHECK/UNIQUE/indexes. LIKE does not copy FKs/triggers. No FK/trigger costs in any layout.
methodology.writes: identical JSON batches, one transaction and one data-modifying CTE per batch; no Projector, broker, network quorum or control mutations
methodology.reads: existing PostgresPiSessionStorage + schema-local read views; warm cache, sequential round-robin; latency includes Node/socket/JSON decoding
methodology.scope: read equivalence and query plans, NOT complete Pi write conformance or production cutover acceptance
